meta.description: Optimized weekly study schedule for maximum improvement per hour

principles: Consistency > intensity. 30 min daily > 3 hours once
Active recall > passive reading. Solve, don't just read
Interleave: mix openings, middlegame, endgame each week
Practice like you play: clock, notation, no takebacks
Analyze YOUR games: highest ROI activity

activities: Play 2 blitz games testing it (20 min)
Quick analysis of critical moments (10 min)
monday.rotation: Week 1: Main line | Week 2: Anti-X | Week 3: Side line | Week 4: Review all
monday.output: Update repertoire notes with new ideas/problems

activities: Find 3 model games exemplifying it (15 min)
Play 1 training game from thematic position vs engine (10 min)
Play 2 blitz games as Black (20 min)
wednesday.rotation: Same as Monday but for Black

activities: Theoretical position drill (15 min) - from drills.json
Select 1 recent game (loss or win with questions)
Update opening repertoire if needed (10 min)
Play through 1 model game from your style (30 min)
Weekly review: check metrics, plan next week (15 min)
Spaced repetition review: due flashcards (15 min)
sunday.output: Model game notes, updated study plan

monthlyFocus.month1: Foundations: London + Caro-Kann + Slav, Center Control, K+P + Rook basics
monthlyFocus.month2: Italian + Caro-Kann + Slav, Piece Activity, Rook endgames
monthlyFocus.month3: Italian + Classical 1...e5 + QGD, Weaknesses, Minor piece endings
monthlyFocus.month4: Scotch + Sicilian/KID, Pawn Breaks, Queen endings
monthlyFocus.month5: Evans/King's Gambit situational, Prophylaxis, Complex conversions
monthlyFocus.month6: Full repertoire integration, King Safety/Attack, Time pressure drills

cards: Model game critical positions -> best move/plan
spacedRepetition.schedule: Daily 10 min review. New cards from weekly study.
spacedRepetition.mastery: Card graduates after 5 correct reviews at increasing intervals

monthly.review: Last Sunday: deep dive, adjust plan

quarterly.assessment: Play 5 classical games (OTB or online 30+ min)
quarterly.adjustment: Major plan revision, possibly repertoire changes

efficiencyTips: Prepare positions beforehand (don't waste study time setting up)
Use same engine depth for consistency
Voice notes during analysis -> transcribe later
Combine: listen to chess podcast while commuting
Physical board for deep analysis, screen for drills
Sleep on difficult positions - subconscious works
Teach concepts to imaginary student (Feynman technique)

emergencyMode.philosophy: Consistency maintains neural pathways. Something > nothing.
